x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_01.desc: We cannot talk about affordable rent without talking about building more homes.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_02.desc: Housing supply is not the whole story, but shortages make every rent increase hurt more. What would a workable policy look like?

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_03.desc: Why are apartments so hard to build near jobs and public transit?

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_04.desc: Should cities allow more duplexes and small apartment buildings in single-family neighborhoods? Curious how others see this.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_05.desc: Affordable housing should mean more than a lottery with a ten-year waitlist.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_06.desc: More housing near train and bus lines would help both renters and commuters.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_07.desc: Zoning reform is not glamorous, but it could change what families pay in rent.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_08.desc: How do we build more homes without displacing the people already living there?

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_09.desc: Public investment in affordable housing needs to be matched with local permitting reform.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_10.desc: A city that adds jobs but blocks new housing is creating its own rent problem. Thoughts?

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_11.desc: Would faster approvals for apartment construction lower rents over time?

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_12.desc: Teachers and service workers should be able to live near the communities they serve.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_13.desc: We need affordable options for seniors, young adults, and families—not just luxury towers.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_14.desc: The housing crisis looks different in rural areas, suburbs, and major cities. Anyone seen this handled well locally?

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_15.desc: Can vacant office buildings realistically be converted into affordable apartments?

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_16.desc: Building more is important, but tenant protections matter during the transition.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_17.desc: The rent debate should include land costs, infrastructure, and construction labor.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_18.desc: What is your city doing to make starter homes and modest rentals possible?

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_19.desc: Affordable housing plans fail if residents have no access to work, schools, or transit.

x_rent_too_high_aebcfb_20.desc: If everyone agrees rent is too high, what housing trade-offs are we willing to make?
